dependencies.name: HyperFrames 0.8.140, GSAP and Chrome headless shell

install.summary: Install HyperFrames 0.8.140 (Apache-2.0) and GSAP 3.14.2 with npm into the plugin's data folder (about 130 MB) and download the Chrome headless shell it renders with (about 210 MB). A Node.js 22.19 or newer already on this Mac is used; otherwise the official Node.js 22 LTS is downloaded from nodejs.org and checked against its SHA-256. Telemetry stays off.
